categories.name: Document Name
categories.description: The formal title or name of the agreement or contract.
categories.mitigation_guidance: Ensure document title accurately reflects the legal structure and obligations.

categories.name: Parties
categories.description: The legal names and corporate forms of each contracting entity.
categories.mitigation_guidance: Verify full legal entity names, state of incorporation, and registered office addresses.

categories.name: Agreement Date
categories.description: The date when the contract was executed or signed.
categories.mitigation_guidance: Confirm agreement date matches signature block execution dates.

categories.name: Effective Date
categories.description: The date upon which the rights and obligations under the agreement become enforceable.
categories.mitigation_guidance: Ensure effective date is clearly defined and does not apply retroactive liability without explicit agreement.

categories.name: Expiration Date
categories.description: The fixed calendar date or triggering event on which the initial term of the contract ends.
categories.mitigation_guidance: Avoid indefinite terms without clear termination mechanisms.

categories.name: Renewal Term
categories.description: Provisions governing automatic or optional extension of the contract term.
categories.standard_safe_clause: This Agreement shall renew only upon the mutual written agreement of both Parties executed at least thirty (30) days prior to the expiration of the current Term.
categories.mitigation_guidance: Flag evergreen automatic renewals. Mandate written mutual consent or minimum 30-60 day non-renewal notice window.

categories.name: Notice Period To Terminate Renewal
categories.description: The required notice timeframe prior to the expiration date to prevent automatic renewal.
categories.mitigation_guidance: Maintain a 30 to 60-day notice window to avoid accidental lock-in.

categories.name: Governing Law
categories.description: The jurisdiction whose laws govern the interpretation and enforcement of the contract.
categories.standard_safe_clause: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware, without regard to its conflict of law principles.
categories.mitigation_guidance: Align governing law with company standard jurisdictions (e.g. Delaware, New York, England & Wales).

categories.name: Most Favored Nation (MFN)
categories.description: A clause requiring the vendor to give the customer pricing/terms equal to or better than those offered to any other customer.
keywords: lowest price offered to any third party
risk_triggers: strict MFN obligation on supplier without volume parity
categories.mitigation_guidance: If vendor, resist MFN clauses as they restrict commercial pricing flexibility and create audit exposure.

categories.name: Non-Compete
categories.description: Restrictions on a party's ability to engage in competing business, serve certain clients, or operate in specific territories.
categories.standard_safe_clause: Neither Party shall be restricted from conducting its general business or providing services to other clients, provided confidential information is not disclosed or utilized.
categories.mitigation_guidance: Strike broad non-competes. If unavoidable, limit strictly to direct named competitors, narrow geographic scope, and max 6-12 months.

categories.name: Exclusivity
categories.description: Commitment granting exclusive rights to supply, distribute, or purchase goods/services.
keywords: shall not purchase from any other
risk_triggers: unilateral exclusivity without minimum revenue guarantees
categories.mitigation_guidance: Condition exclusivity on aggressive minimum purchase thresholds and permit termination of exclusivity upon shortfall.

categories.name: No-Solicit Of Employees
categories.description: Restriction preventing a party from actively recruiting, soliciting, or hiring the other party's staff.
risk_triggers: restriction extends to general job postings
categories.standard_safe_clause: During the term and for one (1) year thereafter, neither Party shall directly solicit the other Party's personnel who performed under this Agreement, excluding general public job advertisements.
categories.mitigation_guidance: Include standard carve-outs for general job solicitations and bona fide job board applications.

categories.name: No-Solicit Of Customers
categories.description: Restrictions prohibiting a party from soliciting or diverting the other party's customers or clients.
risk_triggers: extends to customers known prior to relationship
categories.mitigation_guidance: Ensure non-solicitation only applies to customers directly introduced or engaged during project scope.

categories.name: Competitive Restriction Exception
categories.description: Carve-outs explicitly permitting certain competitive or pre-existing lines of business.
categories.mitigation_guidance: Preserve existing product roadmaps and customer bases via explicit carve-outs.

categories.name: No-Hire
categories.description: Strict prohibition against employing or contracting with the other party's staff even if unprompted.
categories.mitigation_guidance: Prefer non-solicitation over absolute no-hire provisions to avoid antitrust or labor law enforceability issues.

categories.name: Non-Disparagement
categories.description: Obligation prohibiting either party from making defamatory or negative statements about the other.
categories.mitigation_guidance: Ensure obligation is strictly mutual and contains standard carve-outs for legal testimony and regulatory filings.

categories.name: Termination For Convenience
categories.description: Right of a party to terminate the contract at will without showing breach or fault.
risk_triggers: unilateral right held only by counterparty
short notice period < 30 days without pro-rata refund
categories.standard_safe_clause: Either Party may terminate this Agreement for convenience at any time upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to the other Party.
categories.mitigation_guidance: Ensure termination for convenience is bilateral, requires 30-60 days written notice, and provides pro-rata refund/payment for work completed.

categories.name: Right of First Refusal / First Offer (ROFR/ROFO)
categories.description: Preferential right to match third-party offers or be offered assets/licenses before outside buyers.
categories.mitigation_guidance: Ensure response timelines are strictly limited (e.g., 10-15 business days) to avoid transaction paralysis.

categories.name: Change Of Control
categories.description: Provisions triggered when a party undergoes a merger, acquisition, majority share transfer, or asset sale.
risk_triggers: immediate termination on change of control
categories.mitigation_guidance: Carve out internal reorganizations and require termination right only if acquirer is a direct direct competitor.

categories.name: Anti-Assignment
categories.description: Prohibition against assigning rights or delegating duties under the agreement to third parties.
risk_triggers: absolute bar on assignment even in M&A or corporate restructuring
categories.standard_safe_clause: Neither Party may assign this Agreement without prior written consent, except to an affiliate or in connection with a merger, acquisition, or sale of substantially all assets.
categories.mitigation_guidance: Always include carve-out allowing assignment to affiliates or M&A successor entities without consent.

categories.name: Revenue / Profit Sharing
categories.description: Obligation to share gross revenues, net profits, royalties, or milestone earnings.
categories.mitigation_guidance: Clearly define 'Net Revenue' and deduct allowable expenses, returns, taxes, and shipping.

categories.name: Price Restriction
categories.description: Caps or floors on pricing adjustments, inflationary indexation, or resale pricing.
keywords: shall not increase prices by more than
categories.mitigation_guidance: Ensure annual price escalation indexation (CPI + 3-5%) is permitted in long-term contracts.

categories.name: Minimum Commitment
categories.description: Minimum financial or volume purchase obligation regardless of actual usage or consumption.
risk_triggers: take-or-pay clauses with high financial penalties upon shortfall
categories.mitigation_guidance: Avoid harsh take-or-pay penalties; tie commitments to graduated tier discounts instead.

categories.name: Volume Restriction
categories.description: Limits on transaction volume, API requests, user seats, or processing bandwidth.
categories.mitigation_guidance: Clearly define overage rates and ensure grace periods for temporary usage spikes.

categories.name: IP Ownership Assignment
categories.description: Provisions transferring or assigning intellectual property created under or prior to the agreement.
keywords: assigns all right title and interest
categories.standard_safe_clause: Each Party retains all right, title, and interest in its pre-existing Intellectual Property. Customer owns deliverables specifically created and paid for, excluding Provider's underlying platform and core IP.
categories.mitigation_guidance: Vigorously defend pre-existing IP and background technology. Limit customer assignments strictly to bespoke deliverables.

categories.name: Joint IP Ownership
categories.description: Clauses assigning shared intellectual property rights to newly created technology.
risk_triggers: joint ownership without clear commercial exploitation or licensing rules
categories.mitigation_guidance: Avoid joint IP ownership due to jurisdictional exploitation ambiguities; prefer sole ownership with cross-licensing.

categories.name: License Grant
categories.description: Scope of rights granted to use software, documentation, trade secrets, or patents.
risk_triggers: irrevocable, perpetual, royalty-free license granted for basic subscription
categories.standard_safe_clause: Provider grants Customer a non-exclusive, non-transferable, revocable license to access and use the Service during the Term solely for internal business operations.
categories.mitigation_guidance: Ensure license is non-exclusive, non-transferable, and terminable upon material breach or non-payment.

categories.name: Non-Transferable License
categories.description: Restriction specifying that the granted license cannot be sublicensed or assigned.
categories.mitigation_guidance: Standard protection for software vendors.

categories.name: Exclusivity Of License
categories.description: Grant of sole and exclusive exploitation rights in a defined field or market.
categories.mitigation_guidance: Ensure exclusive licenses carry minimum royalty performance targets.

categories.name: Cap On Liability
categories.description: Limitation establishing a maximum monetary ceiling on damages recoverable under the agreement.
categories.standard_safe_clause: In no event shall either Party's aggregate liability arising out of or related to this Agreement exceed the total fees paid by Customer in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.
categories.mitigation_guidance: Ensure mutual liability cap is tied to 12 months fees paid. Avoid un-capped exposure.

categories.name: Unlimited Liability
categories.description: Carve-outs from liability caps creating infinite financial risk exposure.
keywords: no limitation of liability shall apply to
shall not be subject to any cap
risk_triggers: unlimited liability for data breach or IP claims without super-cap
categories.mitigation_guidance: Restrict uncapped liabilities strictly to willful misconduct, gross negligence, and death/personal injury.

categories.name: Liquidated Damages
categories.description: Pre-agreed financial penalties payable upon breach or milestone delay.
risk_triggers: disproportionately high daily liquidated damages without overall cap
categories.mitigation_guidance: Ensure liquidated damages are sole and exclusive remedy for delay and subject to overall aggregate cap (5-10% of value).

categories.name: Warranty Duration
categories.description: The time period during which product/service warranties remain valid.
categories.mitigation_guidance: Standard software warranty is 30-90 days from delivery or acceptance.

categories.name: Insurance
categories.description: Mandatory commercial liability, cyber risk, or errors & omissions insurance policies.
risk_triggers: excessive insurance limits >$10M for small contracts
waiver of subrogation required without justification
categories.mitigation_guidance: Verify insurance coverage requirements align with existing company policy limits.

categories.name: Covenant Not To Sue
categories.description: Agreement by a party promising not to initiate litigation or assert patent/IP claims.
categories.mitigation_guidance: Ensure covenant not to sue does not waive rights to enforce confidentiality or payment terms.

categories.name: Third Party Beneficiary
categories.description: Provisions granting or disclaiming rights to individuals or entities not party to the agreement.
keywords: shall not confer any rights upon any person other than
categories.standard_safe_clause: This Agreement is solely for the benefit of the Parties hereto and does not confer any rights or remedies upon any third party.
categories.mitigation_guidance: Include standard disclaimer disclaiming all third-party beneficiary rights.

categories.name: Audit Rights
categories.description: Right of a party or independent auditor to inspect books, records, data facilities, or source code.
risk_triggers: vendor pays for audit regardless of discrepancy
categories.standard_safe_clause: Customer may audit Provider's compliance once per year upon at least thirty (30) days' prior written notice during normal business hours.
categories.mitigation_guidance: Limit audits to once per year, during normal business hours, upon 30 days notice, subject to confidentiality.

categories.name: Uncapped Liability
categories.description: Clauses explicitly removing liability limits for specific categories of breach.
keywords: not subject to limitation of liability
risk_triggers: uncapped indemnification for indirect damages or lost profits
categories.mitigation_guidance: Require super-caps (e.g. 2x-3x contract value) instead of unlimited liability for data protection or IP indemnification.

categories.name: Force Majeure
categories.description: Excuse from contractual performance due to unforeseen events beyond reasonable control.
categories.standard_safe_clause: Neither Party shall be liable for delay or failure in performance resulting from acts beyond reasonable control (acts of God, natural disasters, war, pandemics), provided written notice is promptly given.
categories.mitigation_guidance: Ensure payment obligations are explicitly excluded from force majeure relief.

categories.name: Mutual Indemnification
categories.description: Both parties agreeing to defend, indemnify, and hold harmless the other from third-party claims.
keywords: indemnify, defend, and hold harmless the other party
categories.standard_safe_clause: Each Party shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless the other Party against third-party claims arising from gross negligence, willful misconduct, or IP infringement.
categories.mitigation_guidance: Mutual indemnification is the gold standard for commercial equity.

categories.name: Unilateral Indemnification
categories.description: One-sided obligation where only one party indemnifies the other with no reciprocal protection.
keywords: contractor agrees to defend and indemnify client
hold harmless harmless from all claims
risk_triggers: one-sided indemnity with broad consequential damage coverage
categories.mitigation_guidance: Convert unilateral indemnity into a balanced mutual indemnity with clear procedural claim conditions.
